heading: Specialist Behaviour Support
blockquote: Helping dogs feel calmer, more confident and better understood.
body:
Every dog communicates through behaviour. Anxiety on walks, fear of grooming, sensitivity to handling, reactivity or difficulty coping with new situations can all be signs that a dog feels uncertain, overwhelmed or unsafe.

Liza Smith helps owners look beyond the behaviour itself to understand what may be causing it. Through careful observation, practical guidance and a calm, individual approach, she helps dogs build confidence while giving owners the understanding and tools needed to create more positive experiences in everyday life.
